description: This file defines an internal interface and a sealed class related to message statistics sink in Orleans's placement repartitioning module. It includes a method for obtaining a message observer and a no-operation implementation.

classes.name: IMessageStatisticsSink
classes.description: An internal interface for message statistics sink with a method to retrieve a message observer.

classes.name: NoOpMessageStatisticsSink
classes.description: An internal sealed class implementing IMessageStatisticsSink that returns null for message observer, serving as a no-operation placeholder.

methods.name: GetMessageObserver
methods.description: Returns an Action<Message>? that serves as an observer for messages, or null in the no-op implementation.
